SigninLogs

| order by signInTime desc

DeviceNetworkEvents
| where DestinationIp == "45.133.1.88"
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceNetworkEventId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessUser, InitiatingProcessPath, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Protocol, ProcessId, Account, Direction

AzureActivity
| where OperationName startswith "Microsoft.Authorization" or OperationName startswith "Microsoft.Resources"
| where ActivityStatus == "Failed"
| project TimeGenerated, ActivityStatus, OperationName, InitiatingProcessUser, ResourceGroups = split(ImpactScope, ',')

SecurityEvent
| where Computer == "WEB01" and TimeGenerated >= ago(1d) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-09-07T04:00:00Z)

SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize FailedLogons = count() by SourceIP = tostring(AdditionalFields@bin.IPAddress)  
| top 10 by FailedLogons desc

SigninLogs
| summarize successfulCount = countif(status == "success"), failedCount = countif(status == "failed") by userPrincipalName

DeviceNetworkEvents
| summarize RemoteIPCount = dcount(RemoteIP) , TotalConnections = count() by DeviceNetworkID

OperationCount = AzureActivity
| summarize aggs = make_bag(operationName) by Caller
| extend operations = array_keys(aggs)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), OperationCount = dcount(operationName) by Caller
| order by OperationCount desc

SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize FailedLogons = dcount(AccountName), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625 and TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize FailedLogons=dcount(tostring(IpAddress)) by IpAddress
| join (
    SigninLogs
    | where ResultType == "Failure" and TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
    | summarize FailedSignins=dcount(tostring(IpAddress)) by IpAddress
) on IpAddress
| where FailedLogons > 0 and FailedSignins > 0
| project IpAddress, FailedLogons, FailedSignins

DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIP == "45.133.1.88"
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell", "powershell.exe", "pwsh")
    | extend EncodedCommand = extract("(-enc|--encodedcommand|--ep)\\s*(\\S+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
) on DeviceNetworkEvents.DeviceNetworkEventId == DeviceProcessEvents.ProcessId
| summarize ConnectionCount = dcount(DeviceNetworkEvents.DeviceNetworkEventId) by DeviceProcessEvents.EncodedCommand
